question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Frail
solution:
The most appropriate** antonym** of "frail" is** option 3) Stout.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "frail" **refers to someone or something that is weak, delicate, or lacking in strength. It typically describes a person's physical or health condition. (दुर्बल)
 
• The word** "stout" **means strong, sturdy, or robust. It is the opposite of being weak or delicate. (मजबूत)

Therefore, The correct answer is: '**Stout'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Horrible:** Extremely unpleasant, dreadful, or terrifying. (भयानक)
 
• **Brittle: **Easily broken or fragile. (नाज़ुक)
 
• **Precarious:** Uncertain, unstable, or risky. (अनिश्चित)
